blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Two motorcycle riders died in a road accident in Antipolo City in Rizal on Wednesday, the Calabarzon police said. A 24-year-old man was driving the motorcycle with a 29-year-old woman riding pillion along a downhill curved portion of the road early Wednesday morning. READ: LTO employee nabbed after case of hit-and-run in Rizal Based on CCTV footage from the area, the motorcycle appeared to have overshot a curve, causing the driver to lose control. The motorcycle then skidded before crashing into a tree and a roadside post. Both riders sustained fatal injuries and were declared dead on arrival […]...
